thread:
devon: FYI customer reported a 400 from /v1/invoke when calling the payments tool, says "schema validation failed" :eyes:

maria: Can you paste the payload + error? usually this is required-field or additionalProperties.

devon: Pasting minimal repro they sent (sanitized):
```json
POST /v1/invoke
{
  \"tool\": [\"payments\"],
  \"args\": {
    \"amount\": "1000",
    \"currency\": "USD"
  },
  \"debug\": true,
  \"billing_id\": null
}
```

devon: Response was 400 with body: `{"error":"schema_validation","detail":"additionalProperties: 'debug' not allowed; billing_id: expected string but got null"}`

anthony: Ugh. Two separate issues here: 1) `tool` should be an object with `name`/`version`, not an array. 2) `billing_id` must be string (required) and null will fail. The `debug` top-level key is not in the schema -> additionalProperties.

maria: Customer is using an older SDK that patched in `debug` and coerced numeric amounts to strings. Also IIRC the old client used `tool: [name]` shape. We added strict validation in the gateway last month (canary rolled on 3/2).

liz: That strict validator rollout is the likely root cause. But wanted to flag: customer also complained of intermittent latency earlier in the same session — might be unrelated but worth tracking.

anthony: Quick repro steps for eng: curl ->
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"tool":["payments"],"args":{"amount":1000},"billing_id":null,"debug":true}'
```

anthony: On our side gateway logs show validator block: `validator: reject additional property debug; path: /, rule: additionalProperties=false` and `billing_id: null -> typeMismatch (expected string)`

maria: Customer asked for a hotfix or workaround. Options: 1) revert strict additionalProperties enforcement for legacy clients (riskier), 2) add quick compatibility shim that strips unknown top-level keys and coerces null billing_id to string if we can infer, 3) ask customer to upgrade SDK.

devon: They are enterprise using Private deployment, slow to upgrade. They want a short-term server-side shim.

anthony: I can push a minimal shim in the gateway to drop known-unsafe extra keys (debug, debugMode, trace_id top-level) and coerce numeric order/amount types to strings. But billing_id=null -> we should not silently coerce if billing_id is required for billing. If it's truly optional for them we can accept empty string, but prefer to log and escalate to billing.

maria: Customer confirmed billing_id is present in their UI but is omitted in some flows. For quick unblock, we can accept empty-string for billing_id for now and create billing ticket to force them to populate. Need approvals.

liz: From SRE POV fallback shim is fine for short window, but add sampling/tracing and a metric `compat_shim.applied` so we can revert. Also rate-limit automatic coercions to avoid abuse.

support-bot: Ticket created: #INC-2026 (escalation -> eng + billing).

devon: Next steps: anthony to prototype shim, maria to get customer permission + sign-off on temporary billing accept behavior, liz to add monitoring hooks. Keep thread updated with patch PR and deploy window. :thumbsup:

maria: One more note — please update docs/SDK upgrade guide to call out top-level additionalProperties since customers keep relying on loose shapes.

anthony: Will open PR for shim branch today, target canary in staging then quick deploy to private clusters. ETA 6-8h.

devon: Thanks all — passing this to customer with workaround plan.

maria: tagging @anthony @liz for followup, will mark as high priority. :pray:
